adjudication.rationale: The new controller specs for EmbedController largely assert mock interactions rather than exercising real behavior: e.g., in spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb the “tells the topic retriever to work…” test stubs TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed to nil and fully mocks TopicRetriever.new/retrieve, and the “creates a topic view…” test stubs TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed and only expects TopicView.new. There is no test that renders best.html.erb with real TopicView/posts data (covering branches like the start_discussion vs title link, rendering post.user.small_avatar_url/post.url, and the footer), nor any integrated flow through Job/Retriever/TopicEmbed.import. This is a concrete gap in coverage for newly added embedding functionality, not a direct functional defect in the diff.
